production.note: US model years. 'The model year 2022 GTI introduces a plethora of interior and handling upgrades for the eighth generation of the original hot hatch.' Still on sale; Volkswagen's current US GTI press kit (vw-us-golf-gti-model-page) describes the same 241 hp EA888 evo4 car.

body.note: Golf hatchback; inferred from the release.

displacementL.note: 1,984 cc: 'The GTI's EA888 evo4 engine displaces 1984cc and produces 241 horsepower'

fuel.note: Inferred: a TSI gasoline engine with no hybrid system.

drivetrain.note: Front-wheel drive with the VAQ torque-sensing limited-slip front differential; inferred from the release, which gives 4Motion all-wheel drive to the Golf R only.

transmission.note: 'can be paired with a standard six-speed manual transmission or an optional seven-speed DSG® dual-clutch automatic' (DSG is a DCT). The manual ended after the 2024 model year: Motor1 quotes Volkswagen, "the manual transmission will not be available after MY2024 for Golf GTI and Golf R" (motor1-2025-golf-auto-only); Carscoops: "you can no longer buy a GTI with a six-speed manual transmission" (carscoops-2025-golf-us). From 2025 the GTI is DSG-only. Both gearboxes are kept because the record covers 2022 onward.

powerHp.note: Quote: "produces 241 horsepower". Volkswagen's GTI press kit repeats 'produces 241 horsepower at 5,000 rpm' (vw-us-golf-gti-model-page). Car and Driver's road-test panel agrees: "Power: 241 hp @ 6500 rpm" (cd-golf-gti-s-2022). The 2025 car keeps the rating: Car and Driver's 2025 GTI Autobahn panel, "Power: 241 hp @ 6500 rpm" (cd-golf-gti-autobahn-2025). Carscoops says the 2025 GTI is "rated at 242 hp this year" (carscoops-2025-golf-us); Volkswagen's own press kit says 241, so 241 stands.

weightLb.note: Weight-order step 2: Car and Driver road-test curb weight (owner decision, 9 October 2026, docs/DATA_GUIDE.md); a measured weight of C/D's test car. Car and Driver road-test panel '2022 Volkswagen Golf GTI S' (owner copy), quote: "Curb Weight: 3112 lb". Test car: GTI S (base trim) with the standard "6-speed manual", "front-engine, front-wheel-drive, 5-passenger, 4-door hatchback", "Base/As Tested: $30,540/30,935", "Options: Moonstone Gray paint, $395". The earlier provisional figure, 3,113 lb for the 2022 GTI S manual (Cars.com and MotorMatchup, databases), is 1 lb higher. C/D's DSG-equipped Autobahn panels (2022: 3,299 lb; 2025: 3,293 lb) are a heavier trim and transmission and are not used.
